_port_note: The investor slot selects `meeting_pending` — the one in GameState.pending_meeting. The condition alone could not pick him: it is a global seam, and a bound slot is checked, never searched.
_design: HOURLY and gated on funding.meeting_sitting_open, not daily. The daily sweep runs at 00:00, inside the night, where no sitting may start, so a gate in a daily card's condition would never pass. The hourly sweep proposes the card at the first waking hour of the meeting week, 08:00, when the gate is open. The pump checks the condition again when the card reaches the screen, so a card whose gate shut on the way is dropped and comes back the next week (the latch is spent at admission). The only option carries no lock: a locked only option would leave a modal nobody can close.
